name: Matt Dorsey
why_them: 17 of the 25 watched corners are in his district, carrying 5 fatalities and 98 severe injuries in the five-year record. Every letter the agent drafts for those corners is addressed to his office. Lead with the D6 number, not the product.

name: Dominica Donovan
how_to_reach: dorseystaff@sfgov.org, ask for her by name / 415-554-7970
why_them: Chief of staff is who actually decides whether a constituent-facing data tool gets 20 minutes. Gatekeeper for the highest-value district.

name: Madison Tam
why_them: Aides field the constituent street-safety complaints that this agent's 311 and collision deltas are made of. Most likely person to have felt the problem personally.

name: Bryan Dahl
why_them: Second aide in the district holding two thirds of the watched set. Redundancy on the highest-value office costs nothing.

name: Mahanaz Ebadi
why_them: Third aide, same office. One of the four D6 staff will answer within 48 hours.

name: Ricardo Olea
channel: LinkedIn DM, or SFMTA Board public comment
how_to_reach: VERIFY EMAIL FIRST. SFMTA pattern looks like First.Last@sfmta.com (only confirmed on Erica.Kato@sfmta.com). Fallback: public comment at the Board Street Safety Committee.
why_them: The City Traffic Engineer owns the collision record this agent reads and the engineering decisions it would trigger. If the restraint ledger is credible to anyone in the city, it is credible to him first.

name: Uyen Ngo
channel: LinkedIn DM, or SFMTA Board public comment
how_to_reach: VERIFY TITLE AND EMAIL FIRST. Title read off a Feb 2024 SFMTA Vision Zero Committee document, so confirm she is still in post before sending.
why_them: Runs the program the agent is built around. The 'most mornings it decides to do nothing' framing is aimed squarely at someone drowning in alerts that all say act.

name: Viktoriya Wise
channel: LinkedIn DM, or SFMTA Board public comment
how_to_reach: VERIFY EMAIL FIRST, see row 6. Named on sfmta.com/units/streets-division.
why_them: Owns the division that publishes and maintains the street safety record. Budget authority for anything that becomes a pilot.

name: Julie Kirschbaum
how_to_reach: Attend or call into the SFMTA Board of Directors meeting; agendas at sfmta.com. Also reachable via MTABoard@sfmta.com.
why_them: Agency head, named permanent director in Feb 2025 during a budget crisis. An agent that cuts alert volume rather than adding to it is a budget story, not a tech story.

name: Sean Kennedy
channel: LinkedIn DM, or SFMTA Board public comment
how_to_reach: VERIFY EMAIL FIRST, see row 6. Named on sfmta.com/units/streets-division.
why_them: Livable Streets sits under Planning and Delivery. He owns whether a corner's published page gets redrafted at all.

name: Fiona Hinze
role: Director, Chair of the Street Safety Committee
how_to_reach: MTABoard@sfmta.com, addressed to her as Street Safety Committee Chair
why_them: Chairs the committee this project was built for. A published email on a board that must read public comment is the single most reliable 48-hour route into SFMTA.

name: Stephanie Cajina
how_to_reach: MTABoard@sfmta.com, addressed to her as Vice Chair
why_them: Same committee, same verified inbox. Two named recipients doubles the odds one reads it.

name: Bilal Mahmood
why_them: 6 watched corners in D5 including Jones and Market and Larkin and Willow, carrying 3 fatalities and 27 severe injuries. Second-largest share of the watched set.

name: Samantha Logan
why_them: Gatekeeper for the second-biggest district in the watched set.

name: Raynell Cooper
why_them: Handles the casework where a stale published figure actually bites.

name: Cassandra Matter
why_them: A public ledger of decisions the office did not have to defend is a communications asset. Different pitch, same office, and comms people answer email faster.

name: William Macfie
why_them: Community affairs hears the neighborhood complaints about corners before anyone else does.

name: Jackie Fielder
why_them: Only 2 watched corners, 16th and Caledonia and 16th and Rondel, but they carry 4 of the 12 fatalities in the entire watched set. The sharpest single statistic you have for one office.

name: Jennifer Ferrigno
why_them: Two corners, four deaths. That fits in one sentence to an aide.

name: Sheila Chung Hagen
why_them: Second D9 aide. Same one-sentence hook.

name: Ana Herrera
why_them: Third D9 aide.

name: Sasha Gaona
why_them: Fourth D9 aide.

name: Brian Xi
why_them: Staffs the Bay Area Vision Zero Working Group, whose members come from cities, counties, transit agencies and universities. One conversation is a route to every Vision Zero program in the region, and he is the named staff contact.

name: Megan Wier
channel: LinkedIn DM, or via MTC working group intro from Brian Xi
how_to_reach: VERIFY EMAIL FIRST. OakDOT general line via oaklandca.gov. Warmer route: ask Brian Xi for the intro.
why_them: Co-chaired San Francisco's Vision Zero Task Force from its inception and ran SFDPH's health and equity program before OakDOT. She is the one person on this list who has lived on both sides of exactly this data.

name: Rafael Mandelman
how_to_reach: board.of.supervisors@sfgov.org / 415-554-5184, ask for the D8 office
why_them: Board President. No watched corners in D8, so this is a citywide-policy conversation rather than a corner conversation.

name: Connie Chan
how_to_reach: board.of.supervisors@sfgov.org / 415-554-5184, ask for the D1 office
why_them: Same role as the three priority offices. No watched corners in D1: pitch is expanding the roster, not fixing her corners.

name: Myrna Melgar
how_to_reach: board.of.supervisors@sfgov.org / 415-554-5184, ask for the D7 office
why_them: Same as above. Useful only if the roster expands past the current 25 corners.

name: Shamann Walton
how_to_reach: board.of.supervisors@sfgov.org / 415-554-5184, ask for the D10 office
why_them: Same as above.

name: Danny Sauter
how_to_reach: board.of.supervisors@sfgov.org / 415-554-5184, ask for the D3 office
why_them: Same as above. D3 borders D6, so roster expansion is plausible here.

name: Chyanne Chen
how_to_reach: board.of.supervisors@sfgov.org / 415-554-5184, ask for the D11 office
why_them: Same as above.

name: Stephen Sherrill
how_to_reach: board.of.supervisors@sfgov.org / 415-554-5184, ask for the D2 office
why_them: Same as above.

name: Alan Wong
how_to_reach: board.of.supervisors@sfgov.org / 415-554-5184, ask for the D4 office
why_them: Same as above.

name: Berkeley Transportation Division
why_them: Berkeley has an adopted Vision Zero Action Plan and a walk-in office fifteen minutes from campus. No named staffer found online, so walking in and asking who owns the Vision Zero data is the fastest way to get one.

name: Ted Graff
role: Parking, Curb Management, Operations and Enforcement
channel: LinkedIn DM, or SFMTA Board public comment
why_them: Adjacent rather than central: curb and enforcement rather than the collision record. Worth a message only after rows 6 to 10 have gone out.

name: Erica Kato
role: Chief Spokesperson and Media Relations Manager
why_them: Not a buyer. She is the one verified individual SFMTA address found, which makes her the cheapest way to confirm the First.Last@sfmta.com pattern and to get routed to the right desk. Treat as a routing call, not a pitch.
